recent_news.headline: RestaurantData Analyzes 1,465 Verified New Restaurant Locations from July 2026
recent_news.summary: RestaurantData's July 2026 Restaurant Openings & Market Signals Report reveals verified new restaurant locations and expansion trends. Restaurant companies including Slice House, Juiceland, Walk-On's Sports Bistreaux, and Guthrie's Chicken Fingers crossed operating thresholds during November 2025-June 2026.

recent_news.headline: Connecticut DEEP Reissues FOG General Permit for Food Service Establishments
recent_news.source: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection
recent_news.summary: Connecticut DEEP reissued the General Permit for the Discharge of Wastewater Associated with Food Service Establishments effective October 5, 2025, establishing requirements for Class III and IV food service establishments to install grease trap/interceptors or advanced grease recovery units to limit FOG discharges.

recent_news.headline: Sustainability Trends
recent_news.summary: Most foodservice operators report sustainability initiatives are increasingly prevalent at their establishments. Industrial and institutional kitchens are prioritizing eco-friendly cleaning practices, food waste reduction, and sustainable sourcing while pursuing LEED certification and EPA Energy Star programs.

backfill_news.headline: Restaurant Sales Trended Higher in Recent Months Despite Elevated Gas Prices
backfill_news.summary: Eating and drinking places registered $102.5 billion in seasonally adjusted sales in June 2026, up slightly from May's $102.4 billion. Consumer spending held up well across retail categories despite elevated gasoline prices, with restaurants among sectors experiencing growth.
